content: निदर्शन {%a.%} .²1 Pointing, showing. .²2 Proclaiming, declaring announcing. .²3 Teaching. .{@-नम्@} .²1 View, insight, looking into, sight, vision; शुद्धात्मा ब्राह्मणो रात्रौ निदर्शनमपश्यत <ls>Mb. 12. 271. 14</ls>. .²2 Pointing to, showing. .²3 Proof, evidence; बलिना सह योद्धव्यमिति नास्ति निदर्शनम् <ls>Pt. 3. 23</ls>. .²4 An instance, example, illustration; ननु प्रभुरेव निदर्शनम् <ls>Ś. 2</ls>; निदर्शनसाराणां लघुर्बहुतृणं नरः <ls>Śi. 2. 50</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 45</ls>; जनकस्य नृपेन्द्रस्य तपसः सन्निदर्शनम् <ls>Pratimā 4. 14</ls>. .²5 Injunction. .²6 Authority, text. .²7 A scheme, system. .²8 A precept, scriptural authority, an injunction. .²9 The third member of an Indian syllogism (usually called उदाहरण <ab>q. v.</ab>). .{@-ना@} A figure of speech (in Rhetoric) thus defined:-- निदर्शना . अभवन्वस्तुसंबन्ध उपमापरिकल्पकः <ls>K. P. 10</ls>; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} <ls>R. 1. 2</ls>.
